2 Safety rules M.S.M.
2.3 Carrying out a manoeuvre
After signalling the manoeuvre, and confirming that it is safe to undertake it – the next stage is to carry it out (execute the manoeuvre). This means adopting the correct position, the correct speed, and continually observing in order to ensure that no danger is caused to other road users.
It is necessary to bear in mind, that as a general rule, signals inform and warn of a manoeuvre only and indicate an intention to carry out a manoeuvre.
They do not grant right of way or priority to commence the manoeuvre or during its execution stage.
Each manoeuvre involves variations although the basic principles are the same, dependant upon the manoeuvre there are differences in the execution stage.
(Página 184 del manual 'Learning to drive')

6 Road marks                    
                   
6.2 Longitudinal road markings    
Continuous longitudinal markings
A continuous longitudinal marking means that no driver, whether operating a vehicle or leading an animal, must:
Cross it.
Drive on it.
Drive to the left of the marking when it separates opposing directions of traffic (except in cases provided for in the traffic regulations).
A longitudinal marking formed by two continuous parallel lines has the same meaning as one formed by a single continuous line.
(Página 153 del manual 'Learning to drive')

Maneouvres  
 
5 Overtaking
5.1 Concept
Overtaking is the manoeuvre that consists of moving ahead by passing a vehicle or vehicles that travel in front of you at a slower speed.
Note: This also includes passing a vehicle in the same lane as you are travelling in and /or when it doesn’t involve a sideways movement.
(Página 186 del manual 'Learning to drive')

Maneouvres      
     
5 Overtaking  
5.3 Manoeuvres that are not considered overtakes
5.3.4 Surpassing
If a vehicle that becomes immobilised for reasons beyond the needs of traffic is completely or partly occupying the lane of the direction of travel, you may pass it (without this operation defined as overtaking) after assuring that you can do so without danger, even when it is prohibited to overtake on the section of road in question and you must occupy part of the roadway reserved for traffic going the opposite direction.

5 Overtaking  
5.3 Manoeuvres that are not considered overtakes
5.3.2 Special lanes
It is not considered to be overtaking, when a vehicle travels faster in either an acceleration lane – in order to enter a road; or on a deceleration lane - in order to exit a road and in doing so, passes vehicles. Additionally, this is also the case, in a lane that is marked for a specific route and direction or, a lane for certain predetermined vehicles.
However it is considered to be an overtake, when a vehicle enters into an acceleration or deceleration lane purely in order to pass another vehicle or enters into special lane, whose function is to facilitate slower moving traffic.
(Página 187 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
En una autopista, ¿se puede circular por el carril de aceleración a mayor velocidad que los vehículos que circulan por el carril normal?
On an autopista, can you drive on the acceleration lane at a faster speed than vehicles that are driving on the normal lane?

answers.text:
Sí, pero dejando una separación lateral mayor que en otros adelantamientos, aproximadamente el doble.
Yes, but leaving a bigger side-by-side distance than during other overtakes, approximately double.

Sí, advirtiéndolo previamente con las señales acústicas u ópticas.
Yes, signalling in advance with sound and visual signals.

No, tendrá que esperar en todo caso a que realice el adelantamiento, o apague el intermitente.
No, they will need to wait for the overtake or the indicator light to be switched off.

questions.help:
Maneouvres          
         
5.5 Overtaking  
5.5.2 Prior checks
Before overtaking, the driver must check ahead:
That the driver in front of them in the same lane has not also indicated their intention to move in the same direction, in which case they have priority. However, if after a reasonable period this driver has not moved, the driver can start to overtake, although they should be suitably warned in advance with the corresponding sound and visual signals.
(Página 188 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
El conductor del vehículo blanco quiere adelantar, pero el conductor del azul ya ha encendido el intermitente izquierdo. Si después de un tiempo prudencial no adelanta, ¿puede el conductor del vehículo blanco iniciar el adelantamiento?
The driver of the white vehicle wants to overtake, but the driver of the blue vehicle has already switched on the left indicator. If they do not start to overtake after a reasonable amount of time, can the driver of the white vehicle overtake?

answers.text:
No, porque al señalizar tiene preferencia.
No, because as it is signalling, it has preference.

Sí, si lo advierte con señales ópticas o acústicas.
Yes, if I warn it with optical or acoustic signs.

No, en ningún caso.
No, never.

questions.question:

answers.text:
existe espacio suficiente para volver al carril derecho cuando termine la maniobra.
there is enough space to return to the right lane when the manoeuvre is finished.

el vehículo de delante reduce su velocidad para facilitar la maniobra.

questions.help:
Maneouvres            
           
5.5 Overtaking    
5.5.2 Prior checks
Before overtaking, the driver must check ahead:
That they can return to the right after the manoeuvre with no risk to other road users.
(Página 188 del manual 'Learning to drive')
questions.question:
No deberá iniciar un adelantamiento sin comprobar previamente que...
You must not start to overtake without first checking that...

answers.text:
en vías interurbanas, solamente.
only on interurban roads.

por cualquier vía, fuera o dentro de poblado.
on any street, inside or outside a built-up area.

por poblado, exclusivamente.
only inside a built-up area.

questions.help:
Maneouvres                  
                 
5.5 Overtaking      
5.5.4 Performing the overtake
The driver should keep a side-byside distance of at least 1.50 metres when, outside of a populated area:
The driver of a two-wheeled vehicle is overtaking another vehicle.
The driver of any vehicle is overtaking pedestrians, animals, animal transport vehicles, two-wheeled motor vehicles, vehicles stopped on the road or assistance vehicles when providing an assistance or rescue service. Moreover, provided that the conditions are suitable for the manoeuvre, they move partially or fully into the next or opposite lane.
(Página 189 del manual 'Learning to drive')
